item.title: New Ballaghaderreen park welcomed locally
item.description: The chairman of Boyle Municipal District is warming welcoming the latest news on a new park in Ballaghaderreen. Construction will start next month on a new children's play area and skate park at the Plots area of the town. The project will also include outdoor exercise equipment, benches, and seating areas. item.title: Roscommon solar farm given the green light
item.description: Roscommon County Council has given the go-ahead for a large solar farm near Carrick-on-Shannon. The local authority has given the project planning permission, subject to 31 conditions. Elgin Energy Services looked for planning permission for this solar farm on a 93-acre site just off the Boyle Road in Carrick-on-Shannon. item.title: Valentine's Day spending reveals strong sales locally
item.description: A recent spending analysis conducted by AIB reveals the average transactions their customers spent on Valentine's Day last year. Over half a million euro was spent on flowers alone on February 13th 2025. Men of Roscommon ranked 11th on the list detailing how much was spent in florists, revealing an average expenditure of €60.12 in the county. Advertisement Longford follows close behind with an average figure of €59.41, whereas Leitrim sees a drop to 22nd place, with an average spend of €54.96.

item.title: Solan praises Dessie Reynolds after win
item.description: Longford boss Mike Solan praised Dessie Reynolds as his important scores helped Longford to victory over Waterford. Longford scored a 1-18 to 3-14 win over Waterford with Dessie contributing five points including two two-pointers. “Dessie got us off to a very good start there in the second-half” explained Solan. item.title: Emergency services attending N4 crash
item.description: Gardaí and emergency services are currently at the scene of a crash in county Longford. The collision occurred a short time ago on the N4 close to Newtownforbes. Motorists are being advised to approach the area with caution. Advertisement

item.title: Calls for healthcare facility to assist local patients
item.description: There are calls for a new healthcare facility to be built in Ireland to cater for patients with complex needs. Three patients from Roscommon-Galway are in a specialist facility, called St Andrew's, in Northampton in England. It specialises in mental healthcare for patients with complex and challenging needs. item.title: Hopes for drainage on popular local road
item.description: It's hoped that drainage works can be carried out at a troublesome route in county Leitrim. Persistent heavy rainfall has seen flooding occur on numerous occasions on the R202 between Gort Cut and the area known locally as McCauley’s turn, Local representatives have warned that the situation poses a serious safety risk to motorists and requires immediate attention. item.title: Contraband seized in Midlands operation
item.description: Over the past week, Revenue officers seized contraband with an estimated value of over €105,000 in various operations, including in the Midlands. Items found included various illicit drugs, tobacco products, alcohol and 97 counterfeit items, with an estimated value of €70,230. The parcels were destined for various addresses nationwide and originated from the USA, the UK, Canada, Israel, and India. item.title: Community defibrillator saves Leitrim man's life
item.description: A Leitrim man is recovering after surviving a serious electric shock during a home lighting installation. Quick thinking by locals saw a community defibrillator brought to the scene before emergency crews arrived at Cloone. The device was used to revive the man, proving critical in the moments following the incident. Advertisement Paramedics later transferred him to hospital, where he continues to receive medical care. item.title: Gardaí investigating alleged assault in Longford Town
item.description: Gardaí are investigating an alleged assault in Longford Town this evening. The incident occurred at approximately 9pm and two males received serious injuries. No further information is available at this time. Gardaí are appealing to anyone who witnessed the incident to come forward. They are also asking any road users who may have camera footage, including dash-cam, who were travelling in the area of Teffia Park in Longford Town to make it available to Gardaí. Advertisement
